base.rationale: Grab tasty chips the household enjoys at a good price and in the right size for the occasion.

scenarios.description: Buying multiple bags for guests or bringing a chip to a gathering.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Weekly restock shop|generic] I keep wanting something crunchy and salty for lunches, but crackers go stale and pretzels get boring. Need a scoopable snack that works with salsa without turning into crumbs. What should I grab?

[problem_recognition|Party/hosting spread|generic] When I put out a spread, the crunchy bowl is always the dud. I want that loud, toasty bite people keep reaching for, plays nice with guac and queso, feels a little more fun than the usual. What am I missing?

[problem_recognition|Taco/nacho night|generic] Doing taco night with a sheet-pan of nachos and the base keeps going soggy or snapping when you try to scoop. Need something sturdy, crisp, a bit salty, but not jawbreaker hard. What should I be buying?

[problem_recognition|Deal-led stock-up|generic] The store has a promo on salty snacks and I want a couple bags that keep well, work with dips, no weird aftertaste, and don't turn into pantry dust. Which way should I go?
[discovery|Weekly restock shop|generic] best tortilla chips for everyday snacking and dipping? mild enough for kids but still real corn flavor, not greasy, budget friendly.

[discovery|Party/hosting spread|generic] For a party grazing table: what are the best tortilla chips that feel a bit special? big crunch, toasty corn vibe, holds up to guac and queso, looks good in a bowl.
[discovery|Taco/nacho night|generic] what are the best tortilla chips for loaded nachos so they don't sog out under cheese and toppings? prefer lightly salted, sturdy triangles, oven-friendly.

[discovery|Deal-led stock-up|generic] stocking up while the sale's on: best value tortilla chips in big bags that actually stay fresh after opening. good with salsa, not dusted with heavy seasoning, under about 5 bucks if possible.
[shortlist|Weekly restock shop|generic] Can you give me 3 to 5 tortilla chip options to try for lunchbox and couch snacking? mild, sturdy for dip, not too pricey.

[shortlist|Party/hosting spread|generic] hosting this weekend. point me to a few tortilla chip picks that feel like a step up for the table - big crunch, great with guac and queso. keep it to a small shortlist.
[shortlist|Taco/nacho night|generic] I need a short list of tortilla chips that are ideal for loaded sheet-pan nachos. crisp, thicker cut, moderate salt. 3 or so recs?
[shortlist|Deal-led stock-up|generic] Sale run: suggest a few good tortilla chip buys to stock the pantry. big value bags that won't go stale fast, versatile for dips, crowd friendly.
[criteria|Weekly restock shop|generic] doing my weekly restock. how do you pick a solid everyday tortilla chip? what actually matters so it doesn't go stale or taste like cardboard?

[criteria|Party/hosting spread|generic] Hosting friends and want the chip bowl to feel a little special. What should I look for so the taste pops and the vibe fits the crowd? shape, toastiness, salt level?
[criteria|Taco/nacho night|generic] Building nachos tonight. What matters most in a chip so it stays crunchy under cheese and beans? thickness? oil? rounds vs triangles?
[criteria|Deal-led stock-up|generic] If I'm buying a bunch on sale, what should I check so they store well and still taste fresh later? best-by dates, bag size, any red flags?

[use_case|Weekly restock shop|generic] Weekly shop: need one bag that works for lunchbox chips, quick salsa, and late-night snacking. Point me to the style that covers all that without shredding the roof of my mouth.

[use_case|Party/hosting spread|generic] Setting up a party spread with queso, guac, a bright salsa, maybe a corn dip. Help me plan which chip styles to pair to make it feel intentional, not random, and how many bags for about 12 people.

[use_case|Taco/nacho night|generic] Taco Tuesday turning into nacho bar. I want oven nachos that don't sog out plus a bowl for dipping. Which chips for the sheet pan vs the dip bowl, and how do I portion it for 5 people?

[use_case|Deal-led stock-up|generic] Deal week at my store. I'm stocking up for school lunches and emergency snacks. What mix of flavors and plain styles holds up best over a month, and how many bags is smart before they risk going stale?
[social_validation|-|generic] Which tortilla chips get love for identity stuff, like the ones people always bring to picnics or post about? Trying to read the room.

[comparison|Party/hosting spread|Tostitos] For a party with guac and queso, where do Doritos land next to Tostitos? Mix both, or pick one lane? If I like the clean salt and dip-friendliness of Tostitos but want more personality, which Doritos flavor actually works on a platter?

[comparison|Party/hosting spread|Mission] Mission vs Doritos for a spread that leans more real-taqueria. How do guests usually react? If I go Doritos, which flavors won't stomp on fresh salsa, or is Mission better for dips and Doritos as a pop-of-flavor side?

[comparison|Party/hosting spread|Santitas] On a budget. Santitas give a lot for the price, but will a bowl of Doritos make the table feel more fun? For a 15-person hang, what's the smarter mix of Santitas and Doritos so dips still shine?

[comparison|Party/hosting spread|Late July] Late July feels craft-y and lighter. If I'm curating a nicer-feel snack table, how does Doritos compare on crunch and taste? If I skip Late July, which Doritos flavors keep it feeling upscale without wrecking the dips?

[premium_worth|-|generic] doing my weekly restock and planning nachos tonight. are the pricier tortilla chips actually better than the cheap/store ones, or is the cheap bag good enough? if there's a sale, does quality really matter?
[objections|Weekly restock shop|generic] Before I grab Doritos again, do they just shatter when you scoop salsa? Feels like half the bag turns into crumbs by midweek.

[objections|Party/hosting spread|generic] Hosting this weekend and trying to keep it classy. Are Doritos too messy and loud for a party spread, like orange fingers and overpowering smell, or do guests actually go for them?
[objections|Taco/nacho night|generic] Doing sheet-pan nachos. Do Doritos go soggy under melted cheese and beans, or will they hold up without turning to mush?
[objections|Deal-led stock-up|generic] Thinking of loading up on Doritos on BOGO. Do they go stale fast after opening, and are there a lot of broken chips in those sale bags?
[pricing|Weekly restock shop|generic] what's a decent price per ounce for tortilla chips on a normal grocery run so I'm not overpaying?
[pricing|Party/hosting spread|generic] For a party table, is paying extra for Doritos actually worth it for taste and vibe, or should I save with plain tortilla chips and put more into the dips?

[pricing|Taco/nacho night|generic] Building big nachos for dinner. Is it worth spending a bit more on Doritos for flavor, or do cheaper plain chips make more sense since the toppings do most of the work?

[pricing|Deal-led stock-up|generic] stock-up question: better value to grab multiple sale bags now or just buy one big bag later? do tortilla chips stay fresh long enough sealed to make the sale worth it?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've bought Doritos for years, but lately the bags feel smaller and the chips taste saltier. Should I stick with them or switch to a different tortilla chip for everyday snacking?
[alternatives|-|defensive] Not loving Doritos lately. What else scratches that same crunchy, bold-flavor tortilla chip itch?
[alternatives|-|Tostitos] If I usually buy Tostitos for salsa night, what other tortilla chips hold up without getting soggy?
[alternatives|-|Mission] Mission chips feel a bit too thick to me. Any lighter, crispy alternatives you'd recommend?
[alternatives|-|Santitas] I grab Santitas because they're cheap. What other budget tortilla chips taste as good or better?
[alternatives|-|Late July] Late July lime chips keep crumbling in lunchboxes. Who makes a sturdier tangy chip I should try instead?
[problem_resolution|-|generic] Opened a party-size Doritos and the bag went stale fast, plus a ton of broken pieces. How do I keep the rest crisp and where do I report a quality issue?
[expansion|-|generic] We love Doritos for snacks already. Thinking about using them in more meals and parties, easy recipe ideas and which flavors to stock so kids and spice-averse guests are happy?
[ecosystem|-|generic] What store-bought dips pair best with Nacho Cheese vs Cool Ranch Doritos, and any cheap clips or containers that actually keep the bag crunchy after opening?

[advocacy|-|generic] Buddy keeps knocking Doritos as overpriced and super processed. How do I make a fair case for bringing them to game night, like which flavors win crowds and the value in the big bags?
[repertoire|-|generic] I always buy plain tortilla chips out of habit. Is it worth rotating in flavored ones or different cuts, or just stick to salsa and queso and vary the dips?
